title: Rank-zero top cohomology of a normalized conormal comparison
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring, $I\subseteq A$ an ideal, $r\in\mathbb N$, and $f:\operatorname{Fin}(r)\to A$ with $(f)=I$. Suppose a basis $b$ of $I/I^2$ over $B=A/I$ is indexed by $\operatorname{Fin}(r)$ and satisfies $b_i=f_i\bmod I^2$ [def-sc-koszul-conormal-comparison]. Let $\varphi$ be an $A$-linear cochain map from the signed dual Koszul complex [def-sc-koszul-dual-complex] to $\bigwedge_B^r\operatorname{Hom}_B(I/I^2,B)$ concentrated in degree $r$, satisfying the determinant normalization [def-sc-koszul-conormal-comparison]. The induced map $H^r(\varphi)$ is an isomorphism. No Koszul-regularity is assumed.

source.place: Tag 0BQZ, lemma-regular-immersion-ext, local signed dual Koszul computation; read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0BQZ

proof.text: The range of the empty sequence is empty, so hf gives I = 0. The equivalence exteriorPower.zeroEquiv expands every zeroth exterior-power vector as its scalar coefficient times the empty wedge. The determinant pairing of two empty wedges is 1, by exteriorPower.pairingDual_ιMulti_ιMulti.

Apply the determinant normalization to the empty family. In zero exterior-power coordinates, the degree-zero component sends a functional x to x(empty wedge) modulo I. Since I = 0, the quotient map is injective. Two functionals with equal values on the empty wedge agree on every vector by the scalar expansion. For surjectivity, lift the scalar coordinate of an arbitrary target through the quotient map and take that scalar times exteriorPower.zeroEquiv as the functional. This proves the degree-zero component is bijective and hence an isomorphism in ModuleCat.

For n > 0, every alternating generator of the nth exterior power of the zero module vanishes because its zeroth coordinate is zero. The generators span, so this exterior power and its dual are zero. Thus each positive-degree source term is zero, and the corresponding single-complex target term is zero as well. Each component of the comparison is an isomorphism. Apply HomologicalComplex.Hom.isIso_of_components and preservation of isomorphisms by the homology functor.

lean.statement:
theorem koszul_conormal_comparison_isIso_top_homology_zero
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (I : Ideal A) (f : Fin 0 → A)
    (hf : Ideal.span (Set.range f) = I)
    (b : Module.Basis (Fin 0) (A ⧸ I) I.Cotangent)
    (hb : ∀ i, b i = koszulConormalVector A I 0 f hf (Finsupp.single i 1))
    (φ : koszulDualComplex A 0 f ⟶
      (HomologicalComplex.single (ModuleCat A) (ComplexShape.up ℕ) 0).obj
        (koszulNormalDeterminant A I 0))
    (hφ : IsKoszulConormalComparison A I 0 f hf φ) :
    IsIso (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap φ 0)
